purpose: Functional contract for the subset of legacy Gravita engine operations selected as candidates for the new Gravita core. This is not a clone of the legacy registry.
selection_policy: Only document, relief, tool-database, CAM and simulation operations within the new product scope. Interactive vector authoring, bitmap editing, UI/dialog/window commands and ArtCAM menu aliases are excluded. Legacy commands without a reliable generated parameter schema are not silently treated as parameterless.
parameter_policy: Parameter names, types, defaults and bounds below are copied from the legacy generated schema as a starting contract. New Gravita may normalize them; changes must be deliberate and reflected in this file.
